description: Intake resolver for a single campaign: given ANY ONE of the four campaign id types (marketing_campaign_id, marketing_campaign_group_id, campaign_id, campaign_group_id) as a filter, returns that campaign's other three ids plus os_client_id, campaign_name, campaign_type, campaign_subtype, bidding_strategy and campaign_status. Use it to normalise a user-supplied campaign id before any campaign-scoped analysis, and to read bidding_strategy (CPC/AUTO_CPC vs CPM/AUTO_CPM) which decides whether the analysis is CPC- or CPM-shaped. Point-in-time dimension lookup: no date window applies. Filter on exactly one id attribute; requesting it unfiltered returns every campaign in the agency. No real metrics - a placeholder_metric is included to satisfy the fetch layer.

query.REPORTING: SELECT __ATTRIBUTES__, __METRICS__ FROM reporting.campaign_tagging_data AS ctd INNER JOIN reporting.clients AS cl ON cl.client_id = ctd.client_id LEFT JOIN reporting.marketing_campaign_dimensions AS mcd ON ctd.marketing_campaign_id = mcd.marketing_campaign_id AND ctd.client_id = mcd.client_id WHERE cl.agency_id = '__AGENCY_ID__' AND __FILTER__ GROUP BY __ATTRIBUTES_GROUP_BY__ ORDER BY __ATTRIBUTES_ORDER_BY__ LIMIT __LIMIT__ OFFSET __OFFSET__;
